# Non-sensitive PDF fixture root

`digital.pdf` is an ADD-authored, three-page synthetic digital PDF generated by `tests/pdf_fixture.py:make_pdf`:

1. Chinese statement `合成资料：数字原生 PDF。`
2. Chinese statement `第二页：仅用于流程测试。` plus English, digits and `https://example.invalid/test`.
3. No text operators (blank test page).

It contains real PDF text operators and an explicit ToUnicode CMap, not image text. The fixture references standard CJK font STSong-Light without embedding a third-party font; PDF viewers may require CJK font substitution. This task validates text extraction and physical one-based PDF page indices, not visual rendering/font installation. The fixture's broad Unicode CMap also affects extraction timing; its three pages are not representative of real research PDFs.

Reproduction comparison: `make_pdf()` must return byte-for-byte the committed fixture (asserted by tests). The helper assembles a fixed test document only; it is not a product PDF renderer or report generator. No real arbitrator, case or private data is present. Temporary failure fixtures are created only in this root and removed by the tests.
